# UDPTimeouts <img class="product" src="media/bb-20x14.png" alt="BlitzBasic" title="BlitzBasic" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14"> <img class="product" src="media/b3d-20x14.png" alt="Blitz3D" title="Blitz3D" width="20" height="14">

```blitzbasic
UDPTimeouts:Void recv_timeout:Int32
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `recv_timeout` | In | Int32 | required | Time to wait in milliseconds. |

## Description

Sets how long [RecvUDPMsg](RecvUDPMsg) waits for a message. The default is 0, which returns right away. Negative values count as 0.
